notes.title: Save-loading fix
notes.body:
Fixed a black screen that could appear after choosing Continue. Your existing save remains intact and loads into the game as expected.

Cynthia's Route 7 Mega Evolution lesson now appears after defeating Skyla, gives a Mega Stone suited to an eligible Pokémon, and unlocks her later rematch.

notes.title: Complete Mega Stone shops and matching version labels
notes.body:
The current download includes the full 49-stone selection in every Poké Mart, including Mistralton City. Scroll through the stock to Latiosite, the final stone before Cancel. Each Mega Stone costs ₽50,000.

The game window and Multiplayer screen now show the same release number as the launcher, making it easier to confirm that friends are using matching versions.

If you used an older emulator save state, load your normal in-game save after updating so the expanded shop menu can appear.

notes.title: Mega Evolution in double and co-op battles
notes.body: Mega Evolution now works reliably in double battles and co-op battles. The selected Pokémon keeps its Mega Evolution after both moves are chosen, and each co-op player can use Mega Evolution once per battle.

notes.title: Smoother movement in co-op
notes.body: Fixes brief movement stalls that could happen while hosting or joining a LAN game. Movement should respond more consistently while network traffic is active.

notes.title: Streamlined menus and field tools
notes.body: Launcher settings and in-game menus have been streamlined. Standard Fly continues to use the game’s usual party menu.

notes.title: Mega Stones at every shop
notes.body: Every Poké Mart now sells all 49 Mega Stones for ₽50,000 each. Both Battle Point counters also offer the full selection for 50 BP.

notes.title: Mega Stone shop fix
notes.body: Pokémon Center Marts now show Mega Stones with their names and prices instead of blank item entries. The full Mega Stone selection is available across the mart network.

notes.title: Save-loading fix
notes.body: Fixes a freeze that could occur when loading a save in versions 2.0.4 and 2.0.5. Update through the launcher before loading your save; your save files are kept.

notes.title: Stable-build rollback
notes.body:
This release returns to the earlier stable game build while we prepare a fix for the save-loading stall introduced in versions 2.0.4 and 2.0.5. A dedicated fix is in progress.

Use the launcher to install the update. Your saves are kept.

notes.title: Mega-capable trainer battles
notes.body:
The Gym Leaders in the final three gyms now bring Mega-capable Pokémon into battle, and Cynthia can Mega Evolve her Garchomp in her Route 7 rematch. Opponents can still Mega Evolve when their Pokémon moves before yours.

Use the launcher to install the update. Your saves are kept.

notes.title: Mega Evolution in double battles
notes.body:
Mega Evolution now works reliably in double battles, even when the other Pokémon on your side chooses its move afterward.

This update also makes the launcher’s old-version cleanup easier to follow with a progress indicator, estimated time, and the locations of files being removed. In-game menus show clearer section labels and selection highlights, and you can choose a supported player character before starting the game.

Use the launcher to install the update. Your saves are kept.

notes.title: What changed
notes.body: Follower Pokémon now stay planted while idle and during regular walking. This removes the small vertical hop while preserving their walking poses and reaction animations.

notes.title: What changed
notes.body:
- Fixes a Route 7 issue that could stop movement after loading a save.
- Cynthia’s introduction and rematch now appear at the right points in the story.
- Update the launcher before continuing your save so it can prepare the corrected game copy.

notes.title: What changed
notes.body:
- In-game menu text, button hints and dialogue now fit inside their windows. Long labels end cleanly.
- Cynthia’s rematch team is closer to Skyla’s Redux level, and her Garchomp can Mega Evolve.

notes.title: Mega Evolution and a fresh look
notes.body:
- Explore with **49 Mega forms**, each with a matching Mega Stone sold at Pokémon Center Marts. Forty-six forms have animated battle artwork.
- The launcher’s Features page now plays the supplied front and back animations for Mega Mawile.
- Mega Evolution works in battle, keeps the Mega form through switching and level gains, and returns the Pokémon to normal when the battle ends.
- The launcher now lets you choose an animated field character from your game. Your choice applies the next time you start the game.
- After defeating Skyla, meet Cynthia on Route 7 to learn about Mega Evolution and receive a matching Mega Stone. Return for a rematch against her team and Mega Garchomp. The launcher makes a separate event-ready copy of supported Redux games.
- Added in-game mod menus have a Generation 5-inspired design, with menu sounds you can turn off in **Unova → Settings**.
- The launcher’s old-version cleanup keeps your active game and saves while removing unused copies.

notes.title: Mega level-ups and menu sounds
notes.body: Mega Pokémon can gain levels in battle and learn new moves. In-game menus now include Generation 5-style movement, confirm, and back sounds; turn the sounds off in Settings if you prefer.

notes.title: Mega Evolution and steadier follower poses
notes.body: The launcher now features Mega Evolution and a guide to all 49 forms. Pokémon follower poses line up more consistently as they walk.

notes.title: Mega Pokémon and battle animations
notes.body: Use 49 Mega forms with matching stones. Animated battle artwork is available for 46 forms, including Mega Salamence’s 67-frame front and back animations.

notes.title: Smoother followers
notes.body: Followers keep a smoother walking rhythm around turns.

notes.title: Followers and Mega animations
notes.body: Followers have more room behind you, and Mega battle animations play frame by frame.

notes.title: Smoother followers and Mega animations
notes.body: Followers keep a steady pace around corners. Launcher menus have navigation, confirm, and back sounds. Mega Pokémon with supplied animations play their full sequences during battle.

notes.title: Mega Pokémon animations
notes.body: Mega Pokémon with animated artwork now play through the full timed sequence during battle. Mega Salamence includes 67 frames for both front and back views.

notes.title: Updated Mega Mewtwo X artwork
notes.body: Mega Mewtwo X has updated battle artwork.

notes.title: A bigger Mega roster
notes.body: The game now has 49 Mega forms and matching Mega Stones. Buy stones at Pokémon Center Marts for ₽50,000 each, then give the matching stone to a Pokémon to use Mega Evolution in battle.

notes.title: More Mega Pokémon
notes.body: Mega forms arrive for Ampharos, Venusaur, Charizard Y, Gengar, Alakazam, Mawile, and Garchomp. Matching stones are sold at Pokémon Center Marts.

notes.title: 12 more Mega Pokémon
notes.body: Mega forms arrive for Serperior, Arcanine, Aggron, Altaria, Banette, Gallade, Heracross, Latios, Manectric, Sableye, Salamence, and Scizor. Give each Pokémon its matching stone and press L+R together while choosing a move.

notes.title: Mega Serperior is ready for another battle
notes.body: Mega Serperior’s battle appearance is improved, and you can Mega Evolve again in later battles.

notes.title: Open your party after Mega Evolution
notes.body: You can open the Pokémon menu after Mega Evolving Serperior. It remains Mega Evolved for the rest of the battle.

notes.title: Mega Serperior gains Adaptability
notes.body: Mega Serperior now has Adaptability while Mega Evolved. Give it Serperiorite and press L+R together while choosing a move.

notes.title: Mega Serperior battle fix
notes.body: Mega Serperior now keeps its form and stats through battle, then returns to normal when the battle ends.

notes.title: Fix for a Windows startup problem
notes.body: Fixed a Windows issue that could prevent the game from opening. Close the emulator before updating, then start it again from the launcher.

notes.title: Mega Serperior update
notes.body: Continue using Serperiorite to Mega Evolve Serperior during battle. Press L+R together while choosing a move.

notes.title: Mega Serperior in battle
notes.body: Mega Serperior and Serperiorite are available in supported Blaze Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1 games. Hold L+R together while choosing a move to Mega Evolve.

notes.title: Mega Serperior preview
notes.body: Mega Serperior’s battle form and stats are available in this preview. Give it Serperiorite and hold L+R together while choosing a move.

notes.title: Mega Serperior arrives
notes.body: Mega Evolve Serperior in supported English Blaze Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1 games. Give it Serperiorite, then hold L+R together while choosing a move in battle.

notes.title: Smoother LAN hosting
notes.body: Hosting a local game now handles several network events more smoothly.

notes.title: Safer game updates
notes.body: Updates install beside your current game, so you can finish playing before switching. Your ROMs, saves, and settings stay in place.

notes.title: Smoother Pokémon followers
notes.body: Followers move more smoothly, stay visible through brief connection hiccups, and update when your party or area changes. Shiny followers use the odds from your game.

notes.title: Repair older launcher shortcuts
notes.body: Use Repair-Launcher.exe once if an older desktop shortcut still opens an outdated launcher. Your game profiles, saves, and backups stay in place.

notes.title: Smoother launcher updates
notes.body: After an update, the launcher opens the new game version. Older shortcuts can also open the latest launcher without changing your saves or settings.

notes.title: Trainer search and a flight shortcut
notes.body: Find practice trainers by name or class before starting a battle that does not change story progress. The Fly shortcut opens the game’s usual party menu and destinations.

notes.title: Spend time with your companion
notes.body: Talk to, pet, praise, and play with your lead Pokémon. Face it and press R+A, or tap its sprite, to open the interaction menu.

notes.title: Balanced solo experience
notes.body: The extra experience earned in solo battles has been adjusted for a steadier pace.

notes.title: Free up storage safely
notes.body: Remove unused older game copies from the launcher to make room. Your active game, saves, backups, ROMs, and custom files are kept.

notes.title: Manage saves with ease
notes.body: Create separate game slots, back up or restore saves, and use the experience calculator to plan solo battles.

notes.title: A boost for solo battles
notes.body: Solo battles award extra experience to help your team progress while playing alone.

notes.title: More reliable co-op
notes.body: Reconnect more easily and get clearer connection messages and retry options from the launcher.

notes.title: Unova Together is here
notes.body:
Explore alongside friends, see nearby teammates, trade eligible items and Pokémon, and join supported trainer battles.

The launcher includes Pokémon followers, companion interactions, Pokémon tools, save backups, updates, and optional battle scenery.

notes.title: Companion interactions
notes.body: Talk to, pet, praise, and play with your lead Pokémon. Companion interactions are for fun and do not change your save.

notes.title: Quicker menus and reconnects
notes.body: Switch between Players, Pokémon, Co-op, and Settings with the tabs or L/R. The Options shortcut and reconnect controls are easier to use.

notes.title: Easier co-op tools
notes.body: Find Pokémon tools, co-op settings, and game options more easily. Choose solo or co-op trainer battles, start practice rematches without story rewards, and see clearer teammate status.

notes.title: More Pokémon tools
notes.body: Look up nearby wild encounters by season, relearn eligible level-up moves, and use supported field HMs without using a battle move slot.

notes.title: Followers and party stats
notes.body: All 649 base Pokémon can follow you with a gentle idle animation. Check your Pokémon’s IVs and EVs from the launcher.

notes.title: Battle scenery and better followers
notes.body: Choose optional battle scenery based on your own game files, enjoy updated follower sprites and movement, and use the in-game Options shortcut.

notes.title: Bigger LAN sessions
notes.body:
Host local sessions with up to 16 players, and let guests join after the host starts.

Co-op invitations and reconnecting are clearer. Traded Pokémon follow the game’s obedience rules in supported Redux versions.

notes.title: More reliable player tracking
notes.body: Teammate locations and battle status now recover more reliably after menus and battles. The player list better reflects which area each person is visiting.

notes.title: Clearer teammate locations
notes.body: See teammate locations and battle status more clearly. The player list explains when a teammate’s location is unavailable.

notes.title: Easy setup and co-op
notes.body:
Set up Unova Together, host or join a local game, and reconnect from the launcher.

Find controls, optional music, and setup guides in one place. Your ROM and save stay on your computer when you update.
